smartFolderExpression.hint: Allowed fields: {fields}. tags is an alias of tag. Operators: {operators}. Combine with and / or and parentheses. Text examples: 'foo' in title; 'foo' in tag; file_name_ext in ['jpg', 'png']. file_name_ext is the suffix after the last dot; '.jpg' and 'jpg' are the same. Do not use file_name in ['.jpg']. Datetime fields created_at and updated_at use {format} in the requester timezone, e.g. created_at >= '2026-09-08 00:00:00'.
smartFolderExpression.tooLong: Expression exceeds {max} characters. Shorten it and retry.
smartFolderExpression.tooDeep: Expression is nested more than {max} levels. Flatten and / or groups.
smartFolderExpression.unknownTimezone: Unknown timezone '{timezone}'. Use an IANA name such as Asia/Shanghai.

smartFolderExpression.invalidDatetimeWithTimezone: Invalid datetime '{value}'. Use {format} in timezone {timezone}, e.g. created_at >= '2026-09-08 00:00:00'.
smartFolderExpression.unterminatedString: Unterminated string starting at index {index}. Close it with {quote}.
smartFolderExpression.unexpectedToken: Unexpected token '{token}' after a complete expression.

smartFolderExpression.listOnlyStrings: Lists may only contain quoted strings, e.g. title in ['foo', 'bar'].
smartFolderExpression.expectedInAfterNot: Expected 'in' after 'not'. Use: 'foo' not in title.
smartFolderExpression.compareOneField: Compare exactly one field with a literal.
smartFolderExpression.compareOnlyDatetime: '{operator}' only applies to created_at and updated_at. Example: created_at >= '2026-09-08 00:00:00'.
smartFolderExpression.equalityNotList: Use {field} {operator} 'value' for a single value, or {field} in ['a', 'b'] for a list.
smartFolderExpression.dateInNeedsList: Use {field} in ['{format}', ...] to match one of several datetimes.
smartFolderExpression.inFieldNeedsList: When the field is on the left, use a list: {field} {keyword} ['foo', 'bar']. For substring match, use: 'foo' {keyword} {field}.
smartFolderExpression.inValueNeedsString: When the value is on the left, use a quoted string: 'foo' {keyword} {field}.
